_readme: Copy to app.json and edit. This is the ONLY file that knows which app you are
looking at — every script reads it, nothing else is app-specific.
slug        goes in every output filename. lowercase-with-dashes.
androidId   the Play package id, from the store URL: play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=THIS
iosId       the App Store numeric id, from the URL: apps.apple.com/../id437564823 -> 437564823.
Omit it for a Play-only app; the App Store step is then skipped.
country     two-letter store country. This matters: an app can rank very
iosCountry  only if the App Store storefront differs from country.
androidLangs  device LOCALES to sweep, not review languages. Leave it out to
use the default 30. Put the app's main markets first.
stopWords   the app's own name and its local spellings, plus the local words
for 'app' and 'program'. WITHOUT THESE THE BIGGEST CLUSTER FORMS
ON THE APP'S OWN NAME and one of your groups is wasted.
maxPlayPages  raise it for a very high-volume app. 250 covers ~37k reviews.
name: Ana Vodafone
